The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The camera pushes forward at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move toward the white water lily glowing at the center of space. Lily pads drift slowly past on both sides of the frame like small green planets and slide out of view at the edges. The lily grows larger, resting on its round green pad, its translucent petals glowing gold from within and opening a little wider, and tiny golden sparks lift from its center and float up into the dark. A soft ring of light spreads outward from the pad across space like a ripple on still water, then another. The nebula behind softens into a glowing emerald and violet haze. The camera is still drifting forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
